title: A learned net2 that takes its beliefs about the other traffic from net1 v7's traffic head, validation links
description: Round 29's learned net2 on net1 v7 (gate3 students, three training seeds; model-truth-patch-src) mixes the fixed rule, the share rule and the cooperative window by its own beliefs p (a stock TCP flow shares the link) and q (copies of itself do), learned from net1's means, which keep little of that information (exp-competitor-info-v7-299). Here those beliefs come from net1 instead: net1 v7's traffic head (exp-traffic-head-v7-300), trained against ground truth on the training links, replaces q (net2-v7h, --traffic) or both p and q (net2-v7hp, --traffic --traffic-p, so net2 is the three rules switched by net1's estimate), each seed's actor otherwise unchanged and both thresholds at 0.5 as in exp-blackbox-val-295. They run beside the same students with their own beliefs (net2-v7) and the fixed rule at u = 0.25 (rule-v7) on the validation links at campaign seed 21 (the five families) and among 2 and 4 copies. Reading, stated before the results: the head moves the information into net1 usefully if an arm with it gains at least 0.05 over net2-v7 among copies and loses no more than 0.02 on the five-family mean, both over three seeds.
prepare: (cd "$IN/t" && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS); H="$IN/h/traffic_head.pt"; test -f "$H"; mkdir -p "$OUT/p"; uv run python experiments/rule_export.py "$OUT/rule-v7" "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" --u 0.25; P=(--policy "rule-v7=$OUT/rule-v7/rule-u0.25.onnx"); for s in 1 2 3; do d="$OUT/runs/r29-s$s"; mkdir -p "$d"; cp "$IN/t/net1-v7.pt" "$d/net1.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.actor.pt" "$d/actor.pt"; cp "$IN/t/r29-s$s.ppo_spec.json" "$d/ppo_spec.json"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7h-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --traffic "$H"; uv run python experiments/gate_ensemble_export.py "$OUT/p" "net2-v7hp-s$s" "$d" --t 0.5 --traffic "$H" --traffic-p; for a in v7 v7h v7hp; do P+=(--policy "net2-$a-s$s=$OUT/p/net2-$a-s$s.onnx"); done; done; [ "${#P[@]}" -eq 20 ]; experiments/rule_eval.sh "$OUT" val 21 21 bbr3 "${P[@]}"; uv run python experiments/copies.py "$OUT/copies" --split val --duration-ms 30000 --seed 21 --n 2 4 --stock bbr3 "${P[@]}"; mv "$OUT/copies/c-copies-30s" "$OUT/"; jq -s add "$OUT/aliases.json" "$OUT/copies/aliases.json" > "$OUT/a.json"; mv "$OUT/a.json" "$OUT/aliases.json"; rm -rf "$OUT/runs"
run: for c in "$OUT"/c-*; do uv run expliccit campaign run "$c" --shard "$SHARD/$SHARDS" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS" --tables steps; done; uv run python experiments/slim_steps.py "$OUT"
